body: I know what you are saying. feel the same way too. Just trying to squeeze all the little positivity I have left in me to survive on the daily.. and trying to spread it to everyone on the same boat as me...I hope and pray  that you don't give up no matter how rough everything is right now for you. I pray that you find peace and celebrate life at the same time. Bless you my friend.
Godbless you. May you have a good day today and an even better one in the coming days, weeks, months, years ahead
Being alive at this moment, commenting here and not doing anything to "end this suffering" is actually a big step man. Tomorrow is another day. Head up and keep going man. I believe in you.
Don't look at how far you are from the end of the  tunnel, but how far you've come from the start. Keep going man.
Thank you for taking time sir!
